subject: How to include figures to test questions in mirtCAT?

messages.author: 1577f47a6900fc55
messages.subject: How to include figures to test questions in mirtCAT?
parts:
Hi Dr. Phil,

I am Yawei from UGA. Hope you're doing well!

I am currently working on develop a CAT using mirtCAT. For now, I have build an itembank in a csv file, but a few questions have figures/tables, such as ANOVA tables. In this case, would you show me how to include those items in the CAT or point me to some examples?

Thank you!
Yawei

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How to include figures to test questions in mirtCAT?
parts:
Hi Yawei,

Nice to hear from you! I hope you're staying well and safe. 

It's possible to include many different external files into the GUI, though it depends on the type of input you wish to provide and how you want to go about it. If it helps, feel free to peruse the GUI-test file, which I use for testing the package prior to releases, and demonstrates a few ways to input external figures (tables can be input in many different ways, such as via HTML code or by simply screenshotting a table and treating it as an image). HTH, and let me know if you have any further questions!

Phil

messages.subject: Re: How to include figures to test questions in mirtCAT?
parts:
Hi Dr. Phil,

Thank you for your reply! I am doing well. Try to keep sanity:) 
The example codes you sent me were very helpful! However, I still get a problem. What I am working on now is to include a column of Stem into the df argument for the mirtCAT function. However, the image (image.PNG.html) does not load, though I can open the image file (saved in my local laptop) in Chrom fine. My code looks like this:

Question <- c("Q1', "Q2")
Option.1 <- c("A", "A")
Option.2 <- c("B", "B)
Stem <- c(NA, "image.PNG.html")

df <- data.frame(Question = questions, Option = options, Type = "radio", Stem = Stem, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
mirtCAT(df)

I included a screenshot of the generated webpage. Any idea what's wrong with my codes? Also, can we include .PNG/.jep file as an external file to mirtCAT? 


Thank you very much!
Yawei
